core.title: 4-1/2 x 4-1/2 Ball Bearing Hinge, 1 Leaf Tapped Hager BB1278412

text.description_html:
Hager 4-1/2 x 4-1/2 Half Slip In Ball Bearing Hinge with Non-Removable Pin

This is a standard duty commercial grade door hinge with 4 ball bearings and non-removable hinge pin. One leaf has the standard template hole punch and countersinking and the other leaf is drilled and tapped for insertion into a slot in aluminum doors or frames. These hinges are manufactured for low to average frequency and medium weight aluminum doors and frames.

Specifications:

  • Hinge Material: Steel
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.134" (Standard Duty)
  • 4 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Steel Non-Removable Hinge Pin
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Conforms to ANSI A8152 for Ball Bearing

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually
